Excel 文件是二进制格式，fs/read_file 无法直接读取其内容。我需要通过 Python 脚本来解析这个 .xlsx 文件。让我用 exec/shell 调用 Python 来读取并分析该 Excel 文件的内容。
</thought>

<action name="exec/shell" args='{"command":"python -c \"import openpyxl; wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(r'G:\\auto-analyze\\2025\\11-December\\auto-screenshot\\assets\\excel\\AutoScreenShots_20251205_153045.xlsx'); print('Sheets:', wb.sheetnames); ws = wb.active; print('Active sheet:', ws.title); print('Dimensions:', ws.dimensions); print('Max row:', ws.max_row, 'Max col:', ws.max_column); print(); [print(' | '.join([str(cell.value) if cell.value is not None else '' for cell in row])) for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=1, max_row=min(50, ws.max_row))]\"","timeout":30000}' />
